values.note: Pit toilet, bear-proof trash cans, tent pads, fire rings, lantern posts. Songbird Trail starts in the campground.

values.note: First-come, first-served only; pay on site by scanning the QR code in the Recreation.gov app (works offline) or with cash/check in the fee box. Unstaffed; 14-day limit.

note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, Conasauga Ranger District: overflow campground about a mile past the reservation-only main Lake Conasauga Campground, across the road from the Songbird Management Area's beaver pond. Access is a 15+ mile drive on steep, narrow, winding gravel roads; Forest Road 68 is the recommended route with a trailer. No gas or store within 15 miles; cell service very limited. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov: 6 FCFS non-electric sites, $8 (2026 and 2027 seasons), pit toilet, no water/electric/dump; pay via the Rec.gov app QR code or fee box. Old note's 'not on recreation.gov' was wrong (it is listed, FCFS-only) and is rewritten. Access advisory: trailers over 25 ft not recommended, FR 68 for trailers - no 4WD wording, 25 > 23 so no drop. Pin is ~770 m east of the six sites.
flags: PIN 772 m off: stored 34.85586,-84.64955. recreation.gov's six per-site coordinates cluster at ~34.8561,-84.6580 (site 1 34.85570,-84.65769 to site 4 34.85648,-84.65827) and the facility point is 34.85582,-84.65799. Suggest 34.8561,-84.6580. Imagery is full canopy and can't confirm pads.

ACCESS (no drop): recreation.gov notice, verbatim: 'Access to this campground requires a 15+ mile drive on steep, narrow, winding, gravel roads in mountainous terrain. Road conditions change with the weather and at times can be hazardous. Travel Trailers over 25 feet are not recommended. Forest Road 68 is the recommended route for pulling trailers.' No 4WD requirement or recommendation; the length advisory (25 ft) is above EKKO's 23 ft. The FS page for the neighboring main campground says 'RV maximum length 24 feet'.
PHONE missing: recreation.gov gives the Conasauga Ranger District office, (706) 695-6736 ('This location is unstaffed').

SEASON: recreation.gov's overflow rate season runs March 5 to December 31; the FS page gives the main campground 'Mid-April ... - October 31' (main campground closes 2026-11-02). No overflow-specific open/close dates published; season dates left unset (year_round false kept).
